nodes.name: GET /finance-data
nodes.notes: Final URL: http://localhost:5678/webhook/finance-data — this is what you paste into the dashboard's webhook field.

parameters.query:
-- One round trip. Every panel the dashboard renders, as a single JSON object.
SELECT json_build_object(
  'month',     (SELECT month FROM fin.v_month_summary),
  'spent',     (SELECT spent::float8 FROM fin.v_month_summary),
  'income',    (SELECT income::float8 FROM fin.v_month_summary),
  'balance',   (SELECT balance::float8 FROM fin.v_month_summary),
  'budget',    (SELECT budget_total::float8 FROM fin.v_month_summary),
  'uncategorized', (SELECT uncategorized FROM fin.v_month_summary),
  'synced_at', (SELECT max(last_synced) FROM fin.accounts),
  'categories', COALESCE((
     SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
       'name', name, 'spent', spent::float8,
       'budget', budget::float8, 'pct', pct, 'color', trim(color), 'icon', icon))
     FROM fin.v_month_by_category), '[]'::json),
  'transactions', COALESCE((
     SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
       'id', id, 'date', date, 'desc', descr, 'cat', category,
       'color', trim(color), 'amount', amount::float8, 'by', categorized_by))
     FROM fin.v_recent_txn), '[]'::json),
  'recurring', COALESCE((
     SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
       'name', name, 'amount', amount::float8,
       'day', due_day, 'paid', paid, 'color', trim(color)))
     FROM fin.v_recurring_status), '[]'::json),
  'reminders', COALESCE((
     SELECT json_agg(json_build_object(
       'label', label, 'due', due_on, 'amount', amount::float8,
       'days', days_left, 'urgent', urgent))
     FROM fin.v_reminders_open), '[]'::json)
) AS payload;

nodes.name: Respond
nodes.notes: CORS header is required: the dashboard is opened as file:// so its origin is null.

nodes.name: POST /finance-write
nodes.notes: Write-back channel so the dashboard can recategorize a txn, tick a reminder, or add one — instead of every correction needing a psql session.

parameters.query:
-- Manual correction wins forever, and teaches a rule for next time.
UPDATE fin.transactions
   SET category_id = (SELECT id FROM fin.categories WHERE name = $2),
       categorized_by = 'manual', confidence = 1.00
 WHERE id = $1;

INSERT INTO fin.rules (pattern, category_id, priority, created_by)
SELECT '%' || lower(trim(counterparty)) || '%',
       (SELECT id FROM fin.categories WHERE name = $2), 20, 'manual'
  FROM fin.transactions
 WHERE id = $1 AND length(trim(coalesce(counterparty,''))) > 3
ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING;
UPDATE fin.reminders SET done = NOT done WHERE id = $1::int RETURNING id, done;
